data.content_ref: inline:Stratified well-founded commitment: recompute the grounded fixpoint over the SCC condensation of the attack graph (Tarjan decomposition, polynomial), and require that a committed root's acceptance be witnessed within its own or strictly lower strata. Acceptance that depends on nodes inside the same SCC (i.e., cycle-borne) is demoted to a 'cycle-suspended' status that cannot ground a commitment. The base least-fixpoint characterization is preserved on the acyclic skeleton, determinism holds as a pure function of the graph, and cost stays polynomial. This strengthens root validity by excluding self-support-through-cycle from the class of valid commitments.
